title: Wild Mushroom Forage & Lunch with The Kitchen
summary: Guided autumn mushroom forage through the Red Hill and Main Ridge forests with an experienced guide, finished with a forest cook-up: butter, herbs, warm pan, good bread. Max 15 people.
bookingRequired: Yes, strictly limited to 15 per session
accessibilityNotes: Walking on forest terrain; not wheelchair accessible
weatherDependency: Outdoor, unsuitable in heavy rain; all-weather clothing advised
nearbyAttractions: Red Hill Truffles; Red Hill Brewery; Polperro Winery
suggestedItineraryPairing: Pair with truffle hunt at Red Hill Truffles; follow with cellar door visit to Polperro or Red Hill Estate
editorVerdict: A ticketed forage that teaches what's actually edible in the Red Hill forest, finished by a fry-up on the spot. The most quietly enjoyable May Saturday on the Peninsula.
editorNote:
Saturdays in May (9, 16, 23, 30). You meet a guide with 15+ years of autumn foraging behind them and walk the forests around Red Hill and Main Ridge looking for the two edible wild mushrooms that come up after the autumn rains. The walk ends with the catch in a hot pan: butter, herbs, bread on the side.

For curious food people, max 15 to a session. Wear boots, bring a rain shell. The Kitchen takes bookings directly, no online booking URL.

The smart pairing: forage in the morning, drive ten minutes to Polperro or Red Hill Brewery for the afternoon, end with truffle dinner if you've timed it right. May on the ridge is genuinely beautiful.
archiveReason: Final session of 2026 season ran 2026-05-30; end of recurrence window.
